project_name: Miracurl Suite Salon Management System SaaS
archetype: LUXURY & PERFORMANCE PRO (Deep Obsidian + Warm Cream & Gold Accents)
design_vision: A ultra-polished, high-density luxury admin dashboard portal for salon owners in India. Blends deep dark sidebar navigation (#0D0D0D) with metallic gold (#D4AF37) active indicators and crisp high-contrast cards (.card-light) on an animated warm mesh canvas (.app-canvas). Features Mira AI voice & intelligence, day/week appointment calendar, staff management, loyalty CRM, inventory, POS billing, AI flyer generator, and reports.
target_audience: Salon owners, branch managers, front-desk receptionists, and senior stylists in premium unisex salons across India.

theme_rules.card_background: #FFFFFF (.card-light) with #E2E8F0 subtle border and 0 1px 3px rgba(15,23,42,0.05) ambient shadow

headings.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900

mono.use_case: Financial figures, invoice IDs, currency values (₹), timestamps

spacing_and_layout.grid_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6

sidebar.treatment: Fixed dark nav with tenant logo glow (.tenant-logo-glow), animated gold wordmark (.tenant-name-shimmer), active item gold left border + gold pill bg, compact 13+ tab list with tooltips and badge counters.

cards.treatment: Use .card-light class with rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200. Internal padding minimum p-5 to p-6.

tables.treatment: Use .luxe-table-light with upper-case track-wider headers (#F8FAFC bg), soft borders (#F1F5F9), inline status badges (pill-shaped with dot), and hover state #F8FAFC.

buttons.primary: .btn-blue or .btn-gold with rounded-lg font-semibold shadow-sm hover:brightness-105 active:scale-95 transition-all
buttons.secondary: .btn-slate with white bg, slate-200 border, hover bg slate-50
buttons.icon_action: p-2 rounded-lg text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors

inputs.treatment: .input-light with background #F8FAFC, border #E2E8F0, rounded-lg, focus:border-sky-400 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-sky-100. Always ensure proper pl-10 padding for icon-prefixed inputs.

badges.treatment: Pill shaped px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold rounded-full. Green for Confirmed/Paid, Amber for Pending/Awaiting, Blue for In Progress, Red for Cancelled/Low Stock.

screen_polish_passes.dashboard: Daily Briefing banner with Mira AI voice waveform button, 4 key KPI stat tiles (Revenue, Bookings, Clients, Avg Bill), Low stock alert banner with quick reorder button, Live SMS credits pill.
screen_polish_passes.appointments: Day/Week/Upcoming calendar toggles, quick booking drawer, status-colored appointment cards with client photo avatar & stylist assigned.
screen_polish_passes.crm: Customer roster table with loyalty points tier badges (Gold/Platinum), last visit timestamp, total spend (₹), and quick WhatsApp/SMS action buttons.
screen_polish_passes.staff: Grid of stylist cards showing profile photo, specialization tag, monthly sales vs target progress bar, and schedule status indicator.
screen_polish_passes.staff_registry: Attendance and payroll ledger table with salary breakdown, commission % calculation, and shift status.
screen_polish_passes.attendance: Weekly roster matrix with check-in/check-out timestamps, leave balance cards, and quick approval modal.
screen_polish_passes.services: Categorized service menu cards (Hair, Skin, Nails, Spa) with duration, price (₹), stylist tags, and quick edit switches.
screen_polish_passes.inventory: Stock level monitoring table with safety threshold badges, batch expiry dates, brand filters, and reorder invoice creator.
screen_polish_passes.pos_billing: Split view invoice builder: Left side fast product/service search, right side cart calculation with GST (18%), discounts, payment mode selector (UPI, Card, Cash), and thermal receipt printing preview.
screen_polish_passes.reviews: Client review feed with 5-star rating breakdowns, sentiment tag (Positive/Constructive), and AI auto-response generator.
screen_polish_passes.offers_and_plans: Active promo campaign cards, loyalty plan tier manager, and AI flyer generator (.sparkle-twinkle) with downloadable marketing posters.
screen_polish_passes.reports: Interactive Recharts revenue trends, service breakdown pie chart, top performing stylists leaderboard, and CSV export buttons.
screen_polish_passes.ai_assistant: Mira AI chat console with interactive prompt suggestion chips, real-time voice synthesis button, and salon analytics query helper.

general_ui_ux_guidelines.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive buttons, inputs, links, tabs, and key status badges MUST include data-testid='kebab-case-name' attribute for automated test reliability.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.accessibility_contrast: All text must maintain > 4.5:1 contrast against background surfaces. Header dropdowns and overlay modals must NOT have transparent backgrounds.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.micro_interactions: Add .mi-press active scale feedback on buttons, hover lift on cards, and gentle pulse on AI floating orb.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.currency_format: Format all monetary values as ₹ (INR) using Indian numbering system (e.g. ₹1,25,000).

salon_interiors.description: Luxury salon display shelves and ambiance

salon_products.description: Premium shampoo and conditioner bottles for inventory showcases

staff_stylists.description: Female senior hair stylist with scissors in modern salon

instructions_to_main_agent: Use this JSON spec to apply global CSS utility enhancements in index.css and refine all admin tabs with consistent high-contrast styling, data-testid attributes, smooth micro-interactions, clear hierarchy, and luxury Indian salon aesthetics.
